narrationTexts: tiers.js looks correct. Fix the `orderTotal` bug in pricing.js, then rerun the suite.
finalText:
**Suite is green: 625 passing, 0 failing.**

The bug was in `orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41). It taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one.

Only rows with both a discount and a tax exposed it, which is why most of the wall of text was noise.
